ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is triggered if the sub Type is EPP Technical Error or EPP Early closure, the maker comment is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: TEXT(Type) = 'Credit Card Services' && (TEXT(Sub_Type__c) = 'EPP Early Closure' || TEXT(Sub_Type__c) = 'EPP Technical Error') && (ISBLANK(cc_Maker_Comments__c)) && TEXT(cc_Maker__c) = 'Send to Checker'
